reviewOverlay.primaryAuthorityRule: The finalized Arentor DOCX remains the primary world authority. This reviewed candidate also contains explicit DM decisions and a small set of DM-approved, non-conflicting durable facts promoted from the current King’s Spire adventure reference.

supplementalSource.promotionRule: May add durable local facts absent from Master Canon only when they do not conflict and are explicitly approved; may never override Master Canon.
